summary: The document is a call for applications for the Right to Study program for the academic year 2025/2026, emphasizing the universal right to education as stated in Article 26 of the Universal Declaration of Human Rights. It outlines general principles, eligibility criteria, benefits, application procedures, and evaluation methods for scholarships and related student support services. The program is managed by the Lazio regional authority to ensure equitable access to educational opportunities.
